basic.name: Dive
basic.description: Dive at the target, dealing 66~~0.04~~ damage and flipping to the other side of the target.

basic.name: Sweeping Strike
basic.description: Dash towards target point, dealing 119~~0.04~~ damage to enemies along the way. Hitting an enemy increases Illidan's Basic Attack damage by 35% for 3 seconds.

basic.name: Evasion
basic.description: Evade enemy Basic Attacks for 2.5 seconds.

heroic.name: The Hunt
heroic.description: Charge to target unit, dealing 251~~0.04~~ damage on impact and stunning for 1 second.

heroic.name: Metamorphosis
heroic.description: Transform into Demon Form at the target location, dealing 46~~0.04~~ damage in the area. Temporarily increases maximum Health by 220~~0.04~~ for each Hero hit by the initial impact. Lasts for 18 seconds.

trait.name: Betrayer's Thirst
trait.description: Basic Attacks heal for 30% of damage dealt and reduce Ability cooldowns by 1 second.

mount.name: Summon Mount
mount.description: After Channeling for 1 second, gain 30% Movement Speed.

activable.name: Hearthstone
activable.description: After Channeling for 6 seconds, teleport back to the Hall of Storms, instantly restoring 1125 Health.

activable.name: Blades of Azzinoth
activable.description: Hitting 5 Heroes with Sweeping Strike allows Blades of Azzinoth to be activated, increasing Basic Attack damage by 75% for 8 seconds.

activable.name: Bolt of the Storm
activable.description: Activate to teleport to a nearby location.

level1.name: Immolation
level1.description: After using Sweeping Strike, burn nearby enemies for 22~~0.04~~ damage a second for 4 seconds.

level1.name: Battered Assault
level1.description: Increase Sweeping Strike's Basic Attack damage bonus duration from 3 to 5 seconds. If Sweeping Strike hits 2 Heroes its damage bonus is increased from 35% to 125%.

level1.name: Unending Hatred
level1.description:
Quest: Minion kills grant 0.2 Basic Attack Damage. Hero Takedowns grant 1 Basic Attack Damage.

Reward: After gaining 20 increased Basic Attack Damage, receive an additional 20 Basic Attack Damage.

level4.name: Reflexive Block
level4.description: Using Dive grants 75 Physical Armor against the next 3 Hero Basic Attacks for 4 seconds, reducing the damage taken by 75%.

level4.name: Thirsting Blade
level4.description: Betrayer's Thirst's healing from Basic Attacks is increased from 30% to 50% while Sweeping Strike's damage bonus is active.

level4.name: Hunter's Onslaught
level4.description: Basic Abilities heal for 35% of the damage they deal. This bonus is doubled versus Heroes.

level7.name: Rapid Chase
level7.description: Dive grants 20% Movement Speed for 3 seconds. If the target is an enemy Hero, reduce its cooldown by 1 second.

level7.name: Friend or Foe
level7.description: Increases the range of Dive by 20% and allows it to be used to dive to allied Heroes.

level7.name: Unbound
level7.description:
Sweeping Strike can go over walls and terrain.

Reward: After hitting 15 Heroes with Sweeping Strike, gain a second charge.

level10.name: Metamorphosis
level10.description: Transform into Demon Form at the target location, dealing 46~~0.04~~ damage in the area. Temporarily increases maximum Health by 220~~0.04~~ for each Hero hit by the initial impact. Lasts for 18 seconds.

level10.name: The Hunt
level10.description: Charge to target unit, dealing 251~~0.04~~ damage on impact and stunning for 1 second.

level13.name: Nimble Defender
level13.description: If Sweeping Strike hits an enemy Hero, gain 25 Armor for 2 seconds, reducing damage taken by 25%.

level13.name: Elusive Strike
level13.description: Sweeping Strike reduces the cooldown of Evasion by 3 seconds every time it damages an enemy Hero.

level13.name: Sixth Sense
level13.description: While active, Evasion grants Illidan 75 Spell Armor against the next 2 sources of Spell Damage, reducing their damage by 75%.

level16.name: Marked for Death
level16.description: Dive deals an extra 180~~0.04~~ damage if used consecutively on a target within 10 seconds.

level16.name: Fiery Brand
level16.description: Every 3rd attack against the same Hero deals an additional 7% of their maximum Health as damage.

level16.name: Blades of Azzinoth
level16.description: Hitting 5 Heroes with Sweeping Strike allows Blades of Azzinoth to be activated, increasing Basic Attack damage by 75% for 8 seconds.

level20.name: Demonic Form
level20.description: Permanently remain in Demonic Form. Metamorphosis also increases Attack Speed by 20% and reduces the duration of Stuns, Roots, and Slows by 50%. Illidan can now mount in Demonic Form.

level20.name: Nowhere to Hide
level20.description: The Hunt gains unlimited range. Illidan passively reveals enemy Heroes below 25% Health anywhere on the Battleground.

level20.name: Nexus Blades
level20.description: Basic Attacks deal 20% more damage and Slow enemy Movement Speed by 20% for 1 second.

level20.name: Bolt of the Storm
level20.description: Activate to teleport to a nearby location.
